scope: Optional synthetic simultaneous-duel integration profile; the standard exclusive-role runner is unchanged. Not a complete autonomous baseline or gate acceptance.

profile.pose_source: command-integrated SIL dead reckoning with declared error bounds
profile.sensor_coverage: per-beam distinction between return, covered no-return, and uncovered blind beam
profile.supported_motion: forward zero-curvature segments, continuously curved translation only with explicit full-scan swept-arc certification and bounded fixture dynamics, plus stationary ALIGN under full-scan SIL clearance checks
profile.note: Scenario coordinates, pose initialization, odometry, limits, sensor sampling, opponent-speed bounds and timing are synthetic software fixtures; arc/ALIGN clearance checks do not establish physical swept-volume safety, arbitrary dynamic-obstacle safety, calibration, perception fidelity or competition inputs.

implementation.policy_input: Optional role-scoped PoseEstimate, TopologyGraph, fixture geometry and fixture-only destination; referee truth and simulator object identity remain excluded.
implementation.pose_estimator: Deterministic unicycle dead reckoning advances transactionally only after both plant predictions/referee evaluation succeed; position/yaw bounds grow by configured per-distance/per-radian rates.
implementation.topology_binding: TwoRobotMatch binds shared map/topology versions into MatchState and rejects inconsistent graph identities across role endpoints.
implementation.guardian: Selects versioned fixture route-pressure proposals using fresh confirmed synthetic opponent tracks; option authority, generation-rotating lease, pursuit candidate and estimated effect remain role-scoped.
implementation.explorer: Navigates only versioned fixture routes using ADVANCE_KNOWN_ROUTE; confirmed fresh tracks enable conservative BREAK_LOS or KEEP_ESCAPE_ROUTE choices. Fixture goals are not accepted bases and no ARRIVAL claim is made.
implementation.perception: Synthetic LiDAR extractor compares scan returns against static fixture segments; residual clusters enter the existing constant-velocity filter. Policies receive belief tracks, never simulator pose truth or opponent identity.
implementation.safety: Straight candidates use forward scan supervision. Curved candidates additionally require full-scan swept-arc coverage/clearance certification with declared pose, range, discretization and opponent-speed bounds; stopping distance, lateral acceleration, yaw and wheel limits are enforced. Invalid/missing evidence fails closed, with v/omega jointly scaled to preserve curvature when limiting.
implementation.alignment: Stop-turn-go remains available through a supervised stationary ALIGN mode. ALIGN and curve checks are fixture-model bounds, not hardware calibration or physical swept-volume proofs.
implementation.fault_response: Missing/stale/incoherent pose, scan or topology; excessive pose bounds; insufficient coverage; unsupported routes; invalid execution identity; and safety STOP return zero. Invalid replanning identity revokes and terminates active option authority.
implementation.truth_boundary: PolicyInput contains no referee truth or opponent identity. Synthetic ray hits expose ranges only. Estimated portal effect is not official ARRIVAL and no score is produced.
unsupported: validated real-world opponent detection, tracking, or belief assessor
accepted competition target-zone behavior or an official score
physical swept-volume safety, arbitrary dynamic-obstacle safety, or calibrated nonzero-yaw actuation
sensor/odometry fidelity or physical stop/calibration evidence
ROS action server, DDS/process races, MVSim and hardware integration
complete T21/T22/T28-T30 and I11-I14 acceptance matrix
